t: A tiny, low-cost FPGA stick famous for retro game consoles.
steps: Buy the Tang Nano 20K from the Sipeed AliExpress store or Amazon for about 30 US dollars.
Many boards ship without headers. Solder them on first.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install Gowin EDA or the open Yosys, nextpnr and Apicula tools.
Download the Sipeed TangNano-20K example repo.
Build the LED example and load it with openFPGALoader.
Try the HDMI example next with a monitor.
meta: Open Board. From $28.99. A few stores.
